01 · Load two stencils

Place up to two stencils (750 × 750 × 40 mm) into the two independent units; close the inner-lock safety door.

02 · 360° spray wash

Upper and lower rotary rods spray solvent onto both sides, keeping stencil tension stable.

03 · Filter & recycle

3-level filtration (1 mm net, 20 µm bag, 1 µm cotton) recycles the liquid with low consumption.

04 · Air blow dry

Compressed air blow-dries both stencils; open the door and they are ready for the line.

The hidden cost of manual stencil cleaning

Wasted solvent and unsafe manual cleaning are taxing your line

Every drop of wasted solvent, every operator exposed to chemicals and every blocked aperture costs money. A dual-stencil pneumatic cleaner changes that math.

Wasting cleaning liquid

Manual cleaning and poor filtration waste solvent and cleaning liquid.

Chemicals damage workers

Hand exposure to solvent puts operators at risk.

Fire and detonation risk

Electric cleaning equipment near flammable solvents carries ignition risk.

Blocked apertures

Residue left in stencil apertures causes paste misprint and rework.

Slow one-by-one cleaning

Cleaning stencils one at a time bottlenecks changeover.

Sewage pollutes the earth

Uncontrolled discharge of contaminated solvent damages the environment.

Installation guide

Install and commission the SME-750II

Reference procedure for a pneumatic dual-stencil cleaner. Full documentation ships with the machine.

01 · Site preparation

Place the machine on a solid, flat, clean floor with enough space for the two units, spare parts and maintenance.

02 · Air & exhaust

Connect the main air supply (0.5–0.7 MPa, 400–600 L/min × 2 sets) and the exhaust vent to an outer hose.

03 · Liquid & filters

Fill the two 40 L tanks with solvent or cleaning liquid; check the 1 mm net, 20 µm bag and 1 µm cotton filters.

04 · Pre-run check

Check rotary rods, valves, the inner-lock safety door and the solvent auto add/discharge function.

05 · Clean test

Load two stencils, press start and verify the clean and air-dry result.

Technical evaluation FAQ

Questions buyers ask before ordering

What does the SME-750II clean?

Solder paste stencils, red glue stencils and copper masks, removing residue with solvent or cleaning liquid — and it cleans two stencils at once.

Why two independent units?

Each unit has its own 40 L tank and 360° rotary rods, so two stencils (even different types) are cleaned in one cycle, doubling throughput.

Why full pneumatic?

The machine is driven entirely by compressed air with no electric power, so there is no ignition source near flammable solvents — 100% safe.

How does filtration work?

3-level precise filtering — 1 mm SUS304 net, 20 µm filter bag and 1 µm cotton filter per unit — keeps the liquid clean and recycles it for low consumption.

How long does a cycle take?

Reference clean time is 3–5 minutes and dry time 3–5 minutes for a solder paste stencil, with one-button automatic operation.

How do I get a price and delivery time?

Email info@smthelp.com or WhatsApp +86 136 0256 2576 with your stencil types, cleaning liquid and volume. Quotation and delivery schedule are provided after technical confirmation — typically the same working day.
